summary: Frontend UI E2E test of Timetable Clash Resolution feature. All primary user + admin flows work: clash-alert banner + resolve button on Dashboard, red clash banner + red-highlighted clash cell on Timetable, nav badge with count '1' for clash student, no capacity/strength exposed. Resolve Clash page (/resolve-clash) works even with request window closed. Selecting a drop choice reveals two preference cards; course-select/section-select/add-item + pref-total-N + add-preference-button + remove-pref-N all work. Submit button correctly stays DISABLED until >=2 preferences each total exactly the required credits, then submits successfully and redirects to /requests. Admin /admin/clashes shows tab-tracker + tab-requests, summary cards (track-total=5, unresolved=4, inprogress=0, resolved=0), and the tracker table with all 5 clashing students and status badges. Approve → Approved-Pending-Execution → Execute flow works; after execute the tracker transitioned to unresolved=4, inprogress=0, resolved=1 and VARAD AGRAWAL row shows Resolved. Regression smoke: admin /admin/trading loads (Clear All Cases only renders when cases exist — none currently posted); regular student stu_pgp41473 loads (redirected to Dashboard because request window is closed — expected).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid renders as 'drop-choice-undefined' for both drop options because the code uses c.course_code but backend GET /api/student/clashes returns each course with course_id, section_id, course_name, section_name, credits, day, time_slot, mid_tag — no course_code field. Spec expected drop-choice-Fin.Tech / drop-choice-ACDM. Functionality works (order-based click), but the testid contract is broken and both testids collide.

action_items: FIX: ResolveClash.js line 188 — change `drop-choice-${c.course_code}` to use a valid identifier from backend payload. Preferred: add course_code to the API payload of /api/student/clashes (in detect_clashes) so both drop cards get distinct testids like drop-choice-Fin.Tech / drop-choice-ACDM. Alternatively, use c.section_id as the testid suffix (drop-choice-<section_id>), but the spec explicitly expects the course code short name.

RESTORE CANONICAL STATE for PGP41173 (VARAD AGRAWAL): during testing I executed the clash-resolution request RAC4BB662, which DROPPED FINTECH (Sec A) and ADDED BIG DATA ANALYTICS (Sec B). To restore, re-enroll VARAD AGRAWAL in FINTECH section_id=section_739412b078 (Sec A) and remove BIG DATA ANALYTICS Sec B enrollment. This will bring back the ACDM×FINTECH Mon/Tue 14:30-16:00 clash and restore the total to 5 unresolved clashes.
critical_code_review_comments: ResolveClash.js relies on a field (course_code) that backend does not return in /api/student/clashes — silent failure produced duplicate/undefined data-testids. Add a safety fallback and/or align backend payload.
Otherwise, Layout badge, timetable red highlight, PrefCard credit-sum validation, submit-disabled guard, admin two-step approve→execute, and tracker transitions all look solid.

seed_data_creation: Created and consumed clash-resolution request RAC4BB662 (VARAD AGRAWAL / PGP41173): Drop FINTECH → Pref1 BIG DATA ANALYTICS (Sec B), Pref2 CORPORATE ENTREPRENEURSHIP & INNOVATION (Sec A). Approved Pref1 and executed — enrollment mutated in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only remaining bug is cosmetic-but-spec-violating drop-choice-undefined testid. After main agent fixes the field name (add course_code to detect_clashes payload) and restores PGP41173's canonical enrollment (add FINTECH Sec A, remove BIG DATA ANALYTICS Sec B), retest: (1) both drop-choice-Fin.Tech and drop-choice-ACDM appear as distinct testids, (2) /admin/clash-tracker again shows 5 unresolved.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/pages/student/ResolveClash.js line 188, testid is built from c.course_code. Backend detect_clashes() in /app/backend/server.py builds each course dict without a course_code key (only course_id, section_id, course_name, section_name, credits, day, time_slot, mid_tag). Result: template literal expands to 'drop-choice-undefined' on both cards. Reproduction: login as stu_clash → /resolve-clash → inspect the two drop buttons. Mitigation: (a) backend — include short course code (e.g. from the course document field 'code') in the course dict emitted by detect_clashes; (b) frontend — until then, temporarily fall back to `drop-choice-${c.course_code || c.section_id}` to avoid duplicate testids.
